The fifteen Python generators and their registry JSON/Markdown records in this
directory were obtained from Statsinference/stats-inference-arena, commit
8182caf7185845a31a2122e032811bb2254d6342. The repository LICENSE is retained here.

Source: https://github.com/Statsinference/stats-inference-arena

The original Python file bytes are retained and verified by their Git blob SHA in
../source_manifest.json. The implementation in ../generators.py is a separate,
vectorized full-data NIE adaptation. These adapted targets are not the original
principal-stratum, path-specific, interventional or missing-data estimands.

The original registry labels describe scientific review status. Those labels are
not an endorsement of the extraction. Tests here verify specified mathematical
identities and implementation behavior; they do not retrospectively validate each
source publication or its empirical findings.
